matt: Quick heads-up — onboarding vela-96k-int3. Found a reproducible "index aliasing" when a live shard-resize happened during a large prefill (>40k tokens). Short thread with repro and artifacts.

hana: repro/howto?

matt: repro curl (condensed):
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"vela-96k-int3","prompt":"ANCHOR:
" * 28000 + "Q" ,"max_tokens":32}'
```

julio: what do you mean by index aliasing?

matt: after a concurrent shard-resize (scale-down), some KV positions were mapped to the wrong shard id; attention looked up shifted KV rows leading to tail token mismatch. baseline fp16 unaffected.

ops-bot: KV-OPS: resize_event=scale-down-2025-06-12-03:08, prefill_span=42000, live_rebalance=true

bench-bot: quick compare: fp16 vs int3 vs int4 on repeat-anchor workload.

matt: short numbers: fp16: 0 mismatches in 20 runs; int3: mismatch in 18/20 runs when resize overlapped; int4: mismatch in 5/20. int8: 0/20.

hana: sounds like two orthogonal sources: (1) shard-reassignment race during prefill, (2) quant amplification of RoPE phase error. Need to isolate.

julio: can you upload kv-shard-maps and a rot-phase dump? also kernel selection log.

matt: uploaded to BUG-3011 https://tracker.redwood/BUG-3011 — artifacts: kv_shardmap.json, rot_phase.npy, kernel.log, reproducer.py

infra: KERNEL-SELECTOR: selected=quant-fused-reorder, fallback=quant-basic, device=a10g, driver=535.86

hana: mitigation proposal: (A) enforce prefill atomicity around shard-resize events (hold resize until prefill completes), (B) add per-window shard-checksum that is validated post-resize, (C) add a CI microbench that simulates scale events during large prefills.

matt: did a quick patch to gate resize during prefill and re-ran 10 trials — int3 mismatches dropped to 1/10. still not perfect.

julio: the remaining mismatch suggests quant/rope compounding. add a rot-phase sanity check in the kernel path to detect large phase deltas after remap and log an alert.

bench-bot: scheduled job 1755556900: 100-case goldset across vela-96k-int3, vela-96k-fp16, vela-96k-int8. Will report mismatch rates and latency.

ops-bot: SUGGESTION: set 'resize-grace-period=10s' during onboarding canary to avoid mid-prefill rebalances.

matt: will run the goldset and open RFC for resize-safety. tagging @eng-runtime @eng-platform. will update BUG-3011 with eval links.

hana: also propose adding a "shardmap-check" binary that can be run as a preflight before starting a prefill. cheap and will prevent obvious remaps.

matt: agreed. creating follow-ups: TICKET-4982 (resize-safety RFC), TICKET-4983 (shardmap-check), TICKET-4984 (CI microbench).

julio: thanks team. keep this thread for updates; if goldset shows no quality regression we can proceed with conservative canary and the resize-grace mitigation.

matt: thanks — posting results soon :hourglass:
